Battle of Teginabad in 864 AD was a battle between the Saffarids and Zunbil of Zabulistan. The battle ended with the killing of Zunbil and victory of Yaqub.
Battle
Ya'qub ibn al-Layth al-Saffar, the ruler of Saffarid dynasty marched to Bust to put down the danger of Salih.
Salih had the active support of Zunbil of Zabulistan and they bring 30,000 men and elephants to face Yaqub. By the way of Panjway, Yaqub marched on Teginabad which is today located in Kandahar. Yaqub saw the huge hordes of Zunbil and Salih in the battlefield and he immediately picked strong 50 cavalry to attack on the specific point of Zunbil and Salih. Zunbil, whose name was lakan the Lak, exposed himself and become the easy prey of Yaqub and killed on the spot with three other princess. 6,000 forces of enemies were killed by Yaqub, and Zunbil's son kbr or Piruz  with Aharpati and Salih were taken as prisoner
